critical_code_review_comments: app.js:73-96 - Firebase .on('value') listener overwrites local state on every snapshot. This can cause race conditions if a user clicks 'Registrar Gasto' rapidly. Recommend debouncing or optimistic-update reconciliation.
app.js is 1613 lines - consider splitting (gastos.js, ventas.js, firebase.js, auth.js) per <700 lines guideline.
window.gastos/rolActual not exposed (declared with 'let' at module top-level) — makes debugging harder. Consider intentionally exposing to window in dev mode.

seed_data_creation: Firebase RTDB now contains gastos created during testing (Aceite-96993097, AceiteRCA-97096548, TraceRCA-97162592, DirectRCA-97219097, Servilletas-*). These persist in the shared preview Firebase. Consider cleanup or scoping to test-runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Merge fix at app.js:119 (adding 'gastos' to .set() payload) works correctly. When testing via Playwright, note that (a) the fixed bottom dock-inferior nav overlaps the 'Registrar Gasto' button on desktop 1440x900 - use force=True or scroll_into_view; (b) rapid Playwright click after fill() can occasionally lose the first click - workaround: use await page.evaluate('() => window.agregarGasto()') or add 200ms blur+wait before click. This is NOT a real user bug. Merge validated via direct function calls: 5000+3000=$8000 (2×), +2000 uppercase/whitespace=$10000 (3×), distinct Servilletas $1500 separate, chart-gastos-wrap becomes visible.
rca of the issue: Original bug: guardarEnMemoria() at app.js:118 wrote db.ref().set({inventario,insumos,balance,historial,historicoAcumulado,deudores}) without 'gastos'. Firebase .on('value') listener at line 82 then re-hydrated gastos from server (which was empty), overwriting locally-added gasto. Fix adds 'gastos' to the payload so persistence + optimistic snapshot echo works. Verified via network trace: SNAPSHOT gastos array now includes locally-added items immediately after set().
